desc: Modest wood privacy-fence gate in a Florida backyard with black strap hinges, a diagonal brace, latch post, sandy grade, and surrounding fence framing visible for inspection context.
reuse_notes: Use for fence gates, hinge and latch adjustments, gate bracing, post-support inspection, yard-gate maintenance, and outdoor repair-scope articles. It depicts a generic gate setting, never a JK Prestige project or proof that a hinge adjustment alone resolves a gate-support issue.
